rdfs:label: WebPage
rdfs:comment: A web page — a single page on a website, identified by its URL.
notes: Subclass of `urn:solid:CreativeWork`. Narrower than foaf:Document (`urn:solid:Document`): use WebPage for schema.org web-page semantics — pair with `urn:solid:isPartOf` pointing at the containing `WebSite`, plus `urn:solid:headline` and `urn:solid:datePublished` for SEO-friendly markup.

history.note: Dropped contradictory Document confusable (WebSite instead); notes and example agree on urn:solid:isPartOf; seeAlso uses urn:solid:WebSite.
